```text
Open WebUI: settings drift (and --sync), per-model settings
```

Usage:

```
lab webui <command>
```

## lab webui comfyui-env

```text
Write hub/openwebui/comfyui.env (loaded by compose for open-webui) from a ComfyUI workflow file, so the
workflow file stays the only copy. Run after changing the workflow or switching models; then lab webui drift --sync.
  lab webui comfyui-env           Z-Image Turbo (default: 5 s per 1024px image, steps adjustable)
  lab webui comfyui-env qwen      Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (6 s; best at text inside images; steps fixed)
Good result: "openwebui/comfyui.env written from ... (N bytes)".
```

Usage:

```
lab webui comfyui-env [zimage|qwen]
```

## lab webui drift

```text
Compare the running Open WebUI's settings with what hub/compose.yaml would give a fresh install
(a throwaway Open WebUI, no network, about 30-60 s). Read-only. Secrets show as <set>.
"in compose" = managed by compose; "web page only" = changed by hand: add it to compose.yaml or undo it.
--sync makes the running one match for the settings compose manages: stops Open WebUI for a few seconds,
saves a copy of its database first (data/open-webui/webui.db.before-sync-<date>). --dry-run shows the steps.
Good result: "0 setting(s) differ".
```

Usage:

```
lab webui drift [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --dry-run   show, change nothing
      --sync      make the running Open WebUI match (managed settings only)
```

## lab webui models

```text
Names, native function calling, abilities (vision only where listed) and hidden models, from
hub/openwebui/models.yaml and the llama-swap configs. Read-only unless --apply. Needs OPENWEBUI_API_KEY in hub/.env.
Good result: "0 model(s) differ from models.yaml".
```

Usage:

```
lab webui models [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --apply   write the settings (Open WebUI models/import)
```
